description: A loyal, street-smart mixed-breed dog, found guarding almost every household.
An independent household cat, always finding a warm spot to nap in.
A backyard chicken, kept for eggs, company, and the occasional early wake-up call.
A duck that waddles around the yard, common in households with a bit of open space.
A homing pigeon — pigeon-keeping is a beloved rooftop hobby in many neighborhoods.
A small, colorful caged bird, often kept in pairs.
A soft, gentle rabbit, a favorite pet for kids in the household.
A goldfish kept in a bowl or backyard pond, low-maintenance and a common starter pet.
A vibrant, long-finned fighting fish kept solo in a small tank.
A slow, steady pet turtle, often kept for decades in a tub or small pond.
